review:
Fist of Destruction Megamultiplier revisits Hacksaw's street-fight slot on a 5-reel, 4-row paylines grid. Fist symbols that form a win expand into Wild Reels, which gain multipliers by punching through opposing Fighters or wilds; multipliers on the same win are added together.

The Megamultiplier symbol is the twist. Three at once award the max win straight away, and one landing alongside three or four FS upgrades the bonus so all its wins are combined and multiplied by a global Megamultiplier. The normal bonuses give 10 free spins where Victory Points trigger an Epic Drop respin. Hacksaw publishes 5/5 volatility, a 15,000x max win and RTP versions from 96.23% down to 86.28%. Best for high-volatility fans.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 86.28% RTP
